about_the_game:
Experience the soul of Black Equation through its original soundtrack.

This official DLC features 10 original tracks composed by Alex Vuorenmaan, blending dark fantasy, emotional vocals, and cinematic orchestration.

Inspired by the world of the game, the soundtrack captures themes of love, loss, intimacy, and transcendence.

From haunting melodies to epic anthems, this music brings depth to the universe beyond the screen.

All tracks are included in MP3 format and are accessible via your Steam Music library.

Includes:

  • 10 original tracks

  • Vocal, orchestral, and ambient compositions

  • Steam-integrated playback via Music tab
